requires.n: Mana Dork or Mana Dork Creator

129-3525--140.easyPrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura is attached to the mana dork.
The mana dork doesn't have summoning sickness.
129-3525--140.description:
Activate the mana dork by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {1}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping the mana dork.
Repeat.
129-3525--140.notes: The chosen mana dork must produce {U} or more when tapped. The extra mana can be funneled into Kinnan's activated ability if the creature can also produce {G}.

2023-4289-4518-7175.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

511-817-851-4050-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
511-817-851-4050-7803.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1003-3558-4973-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-3558-4973-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

2557-5184-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6289-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6289-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-2447-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-2447-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3240-5256-5631-6462.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2034-5189-5902-7426.easyPrerequisites: There are two removable +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
2034-5189-5902-7426.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2617-4428-7150.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
2617-4428-7150.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying Thassa's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Thassa's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2654-7375.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Shark Typhoon
1618-2440-2654-7375.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Arc Blade.
Arc Blade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Shark Typhoon triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Arc Blade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2654-7375.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Shark Typhoon. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

2829-4907-6556-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
2829-4907-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

997-2301-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
997-2301-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Abzan Ascendancy and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2440-3399-4399-4716.description:
Cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W/P} due to Defiler of Faith.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes and Prosperous Innkeeper triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders spell. When it enters, it, Mana Echoes and Prosperous Innkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders trigger, returning it and the Soldier token created in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice.
Resolve a Stormfront Riders trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 10 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger from step 6, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-5231-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-5231-6097.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2232-3542-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2034-2232-3542-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Palinchron.
Repeat.

1365-1651-2981-6701.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-2981-6701.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-4885-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3967-4550-5042-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3967-4550-5042-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1008-1247-5536.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Undermountain Adventurer and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1008-1247-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Undermountain Adventurer's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

3546-3783-3908-4300-6200.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures of the type chosen with Three Tree City.
3546-3783-3908-4300-6200.description:
Activate Three Tree City's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Three Tree City from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate High Market's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Illusion.
When the Illusion dies, Spark Double and Minn's second abilities trigger.
Holding priority, activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning High Market from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Resolve the Spark Double and Minn triggers, putting Three Tree City and High Market from your hand onto the battlefield, choosing any creature type for Three Tree City that you control at least four creatures of.
Repeat.

457-3480-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-3480-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

1987-4377-4423-5913.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-4377-4423-5913.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak.
When Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

1601-1651-1799-5359-5498.notablePrerequisites: Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
1601-1651-1799-5359-5498.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk, adding seven {B}.
Activate Reito Lantern by paying {3}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Threefold Thunderhulk and a Gnome token, untapping Illuminor Szeras.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Blossoming Tortoise

539-3908-4385-4552.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {0}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Repeat.

283-1719-2872.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
283-1719-2872.description:
Activate any mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting the mana-producing permanent.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability, targeting Clever Conjurer.
Resolve both abilities, untapping the permanent and Clever Conjurer.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat.

372-2719-4089.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
372-2719-4089.description:
Cast Sakashima either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} and commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Sakashima enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Sakashima leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Glasspool Mimic returns from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Sakashima.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sakashima until Glasspool Mimic leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Sakashima leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Glasspool Mimic until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Glasspool Mimic leaves the battlefield, Sakashima returns to the battlefield from exile as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

751-1379-4050-5202.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Efficient Construction triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself to its owner's hand.
Repeat.

2959-4867-4871.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R}.
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}, creating a token copy of Cormela.
 Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cormela dies, triggering itself and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Cormela's trigger, returning Heat Shimmer to hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2607-3354.notablePrerequisites:
Raving Dead does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents have even life totals.
Opponents are unable to block and kill Raving Dead.
2607-3354.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Raving Dead.
Raving Dead triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

474-2034-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Specimen Collector.
Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Crab and Squirrel tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

3542-4050-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}.
3542-4050-5140.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Palinchron, adding {B}.
Repeat.
3542-4050-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.
